title: SPOService.CrossPlatform
description: Cross-platform replacement for Connect-SPOService that lets the official Microsoft.Online.SharePoint.PowerShell cmdlets run on macOS and Linux under PowerShell 7.6 and .NET 10. Repairs the vendor module's broken CSOM transport with a native HttpClientExecutor shim and routes authentication through the vendor module's own OAuthSession, supporting certificate-based sign-in and interactive sign-in via the system browser. Exposes Connect-SPOServiceCrossPlatform and Disconnect-SPOServiceCrossPlatform. Import deliberately fails on Windows, where the official module already works.
